h: Tax expert Tunji Razaq, founder of AOA Professionals and TaxMobile, dies
p: Tunji Abdulateef Razaq, founder and principal partner of tax firm AOA Professionals and the TaxMobile platform, has died. His firm announced his death, which occurred on 18 November.
body: Tunji Abdulateef Razaq, founder and principal partner of AOA Professionals and the tax platform TaxMobile, has died.

His firm announced that he died on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, in Lagos. In a statement, a colleague said the team was deeply saddened and described his death as a great loss to the firm, his family and everyone who worked with him.
No details about the cause of death or his age were included in the announcement.
Razaq built his career in tax advisory work, founding AOA Professionals and TaxMobile.
more: He died on 18 November in Lagos.
He founded AOA Professionals and TaxMobile.
No cause of death was given.
